representative_source: High-Energy Electron Confinement in a Magnetic Cusp Configuration
critical_assessment: High-beta cusp electron confinement was demonstrated; ion confinement fusion gain and a reactor-relevant integrated energy balance were not.

representative_source: Recent Progress on Inertial Electrostatic Confinement Fusion Neutron Sources
critical_assessment: Reproducible fusion neutron production is established; grid losses and unfavorable scaling make electric-power production unsupported.

representative_source: Inertial electrostatic confinement fusion device with 3x3 electrodes for flat neutron source
critical_assessment: Reports stable 8.1e6 neutrons/s at 25 kV; useful source engineering but not evidence of net-energy fusion.

representative_source: Fundamental limitations on plasma fusion systems not in thermodynamic equilibrium
critical_assessment: Collisional relaxation and recirculating-power losses impose severe constraints on broad classes of non-thermal reactor proposals.

representative_source: Focus Fusion: Overview of Progress Towards p-B11 Fusion with the Dense Plasma Focus
critical_assessment: High ion energies and low impurity claims are published, but p-B11 power gain and repetition-rate reactor operation remain unshown; authors are concept developers.

representative_source: Proton-boron fusion in a compact scheme of plasma oscillatory confinement
critical_assessment: Fusion products demonstrate the nuclear reaction in a compact device, not net energy or a closed reactor cycle.

representative_source: Assessing Proton-Boron Fusion Feasibility under non-Thermal Equilibrium Conditions: Rider's Inhibition Revisited
critical_assessment: Updated modelling again finds required recirculating power above fusion output under studied non-equilibrium conditions.

representative_source: Bremsstrahlung constraints on proton-boron-11 inertial fusion
critical_assessment: For transparent p-B11 ICF, irreducible bremsstrahlung limits calculated scientific gain below reactor-attractive values in the surveyed regime.

representative_source: Assessment of the gas dynamic trap mirror facility as intense neutron source for fusion material test irradiations
critical_assessment: Mirror confinement is experimentally active, but this source assessment is a design study and not a power-reactor demonstration.

representative_source: Design and initial operation of the LDX facility
critical_assessment: LDX demonstrated levitated superconducting-dipole plasma research; it did not approach fusion conditions or an integrated reactor.

representative_source: Design and initial results from the Junior Levitated Dipole Experiment
critical_assessment: A new HTS device and initial plasma operation are reported; commercial-fusion implications remain prospective and need independent peer review.

representative_source: The Princeton Field-Reversed Configuration for Compact Nuclear Fusion Power Plants
critical_assessment: Long-lived low-temperature FRC plasmas and simulations exist; reactor-scale temperature, confinement and advanced-fuel gain are projected rather than demonstrated.

concept: Magnetized target fusion with imploding liner
representative_source: Experimental and Computational Progress on Liner Implosions for Compression of FRCs
critical_assessment: Liner and FRC-related experiments support pieces of the concept; integrated fusion gain has not been demonstrated.

representative_source: Magnetized Plasma Target for Plasma-Jet-Driven Magneto-Inertial Fusion
critical_assessment: Defines target requirements and a sub-reactor-energy experiment; target formation and symmetric reactor-scale compression remain open.

representative_source: Mining experimental magnetized liner inertial fusion data: Trends in stagnation morphology
critical_assessment: Thermonuclear yields and detailed implosion data are real; target gain, driver efficiency, chamber repetition and power-plant integration remain unresolved.

representative_source: High yield inertial confinement fusion target design for a z-pinch-driven hohlraum
critical_assessment: A foundational calculated target design, not an experimental demonstration of reactor-level yield or repetition.

representative_source: The Spheromak
critical_assessment: Self-organized compact toroids are experimentally established, but confinement and sustainment have not reached power-reactor requirements.

representative_source: Progress in muon catalyzed fusion
critical_assessment: Roughly 100-150 fusions per muon were observed; muon production energy/cost and sticking prevent a credible standalone energy reactor.

representative_source: Antiproton catalyzed microfission/fusion propulsion
critical_assessment: Physics calculations exist, but antimatter production, storage and delivery are orders-of-magnitude engineering/economic barriers; no reactor experiment.

representative_source: Revisiting the cold case of cold fusion
critical_assessment: A well-resourced multi-institution effort found no cold-fusion effect; useful materials and measurement questions do not validate energy claims.

representative_source: Electrochemical loading enhances deuterium fusion rates in a metal target
critical_assessment: A modest fusion-rate enhancement under external ion bombardment is credible; it is not spontaneous cold fusion and remains far from energy gain.

representative_source: Nuclear Fusion in Collapsing Bubbles—Is It There? An Attempt to Repeat the Observation
critical_assessment: No correlated 2.5 MeV neutrons were found; any emission was at least four orders too small to explain the original tritium claim.

representative_source: The Traveling Wave Reactor: Design and Development
critical_assessment: Neutronics and engineering programmes are substantial, but no traveling/standing-wave power reactor has operated and extreme fuel/cladding exposure remains challenging.

representative_source: The thorium molten salt reactor: Moving on from the MSBR
critical_assessment: Builds on real MSRE heritage, while online processing, materials, safeguards and full thorium fuel-cycle qualification remain undemonstrated.

representative_source: Liquid Fuel Molten Salt Reactors for Thorium Utilization
authors_or_org: J C Gehin and J J Powers
critical_assessment: Molten-salt reactor operation was demonstrated historically; modern breeding, cleanup and commercial systems are still development programmes.

representative_source: Accelerator-Driven Systems for Nuclear Waste Transmutation
critical_assessment: Accelerators, spallation and subcritical assemblies are individually mature and coupled experiments exist; availability, target durability, fuel cycle and economics block power deployment.

variant_or_fuel: tokamak neutron source plus fast blanket
representative_source: A fusion transmutation of waste reactor
critical_assessment: Can relax fusion gain by multiplying energy in a fission blanket, but combines the licensing, materials and fuel-cycle burdens of both technologies.

representative_source: Recent Progress in Fusion-Fission Hybrid Reactor Design Studies
critical_assessment: Potential neutron and energy multiplication is well founded, but no power hybrid has integrated a fusion driver with a reactor blanket.

representative_source: Nuclear-renewable hybrid energy systems: 2016 technology development program plan
critical_assessment: Uses mature components in a novel tightly coupled system; value depends on market design, control, heat transport and economics rather than new nuclear physics.

representative_source: Studies of Fission Fragment Rocket Engine Propelled Spacecraft
critical_assessment: Very high theoretical specific impulse is offset by low-density critical-core, fragment escape, heat rejection, radiological and test constraints; no engine demonstration.

representative_source: Aerogel Core Fission Fragment Rocket Engine
critical_assessment: Funded for concept exploration, not evidence that a critical aerogel core or direct-thrust engine is feasible.

representative_source: Rover Nuclear Rocket Engine Program: Final Report
critical_assessment: Unlike most speculative entries, high-power reactors were ground tested; flight qualification, modern fuel, safety and programme deployment remain outstanding.

variant_or_fuel: FRC fusion propulsion and electric power
representative_source: A direct fusion drive for rocket propulsion
critical_assessment: Mission performance assumes a compact fusion core that has not demonstrated reactor conditions or net power.

representative_source: CO2 conversion by plasma: how to get efficient CO2 conversion and high energy efficiency
authors_or_org: A Bogaerts and E C Neyts
critical_assessment: Conversion is repeatedly demonstrated, but energy efficiency, selectivity, quenching and scale-up must compete with electrochemical and thermochemical routes.

representative_source: Plasma-Catalytic Ammonia Synthesis Beyond the Equilibrium
critical_assessment: Plasma-catalyst synergy is measurable; throughput and energy yield remain far from displacing optimized Haber-Bosch at scale.

representative_source: Photocatalytic solar hydrogen production from water on a 100-m2 scale
critical_assessment: Safe months-long operation was shown, but peak solar-to-hydrogen efficiency was only 0.76% and the reported system was energy-negative overall.

representative_source: Experimental Demonstration of the Thermochemical Reduction of Ceria in a Solar Aerosol Reactor
critical_assessment: Fast high-temperature reduction was demonstrated; particle sintering, heat recovery, cycling and full-system efficiency govern scale-up.

representative_source: A solar tower fuel plant for the thermochemical production of kerosene from H2O and CO2
critical_assessment: An integrated sunlight-to-liquid-fuel chain operated, but efficiency, capital intensity and durable large-scale operation remain pre-commercial.

representative_source: Ultrasound-assisted electrochemical hydrogen production in a 300 kHz sonoreactor
critical_assessment: Hydrogen generation was measurable, but absolute output was micromoles per minute and energy efficiency far below conventional electrolysis.

representative_source: Bio-electrochemical frameworks governing microbial fuel cell performance
critical_assessment: Electricity and treatment are real, but low current density, stability, materials cost and poorer scale efficiency prevent mainstream power generation.

representative_source: Microbial bioelectrosynthesis of hydrogen: Current challenges and scale-up
critical_assessment: Hydrogen and treatment co-production is established at small scale; applied voltage, electrode cost, fouling and gas purity complicate commercial scale-up.

representative_source: A new artificial photosynthetic system coupling photovoltaic electrocatalysis with photothermal catalysis
critical_assessment: Reports high solar-to-chemical performance in an integrated prototype; durability, independent replication and complete lifecycle economics need validation.

representative_source: Plasma-based CO2 conversion: How to correctly analyze the performance?
critical_assessment: Highlights inconsistent efficiency definitions and mass balances; many apparent advances cannot yet be compared reliably.
